newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher on gains by blue-chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher on gains by blue-chips.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed up marginally on gains by some blue-chips, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 9.36 points or 0.13 percent at 1,215.51 on turnover of 76.2 million taka on Tuesday. Gainers led losers by 77 to 51.
"Shares were almost mixed. Only some of the overpriced shares lost in the trading," said a broker.
Bangladesh Lamps gained 124 taka to 5,164, Chittagong Cement lost 110 to 2,310 and Apex Foods was down 45 to 2,295.
